scope: Local non-binding PMO review drafts only; no remote decisions or publication
observation: The existing raw GitHub repository URL prefix check accepted traversal strings that browsers normalize outside the repository. Such URLs could be displayed as purported approval evidence.

policy.rule: FIND -> policy -> validator -> TASK -> WO -> Kernel admission -> tests -> audit -> authorized promotion
policy.evidenceAuthority: Only GitHub URLs resolving within the canonical repository may be suggested or included in a draft; even a valid link is not verified approval.

task.acceptance: Reject traversal/encoded traversal/deceptive hosts while preserving valid repository issue/commit links and non-authoritative draft behavior

prohibited: Do not infer approval from a GitHub URL
Do not merge main without protection, independent review and signed Kernel admission
Do not modify production database or external secrets
